extension.description: Translate Markdown with DeepSeek / Claude / ChatGPT and other LLM APIs, and view the result in a preview pane.
command.openPreview.title: Open Translation Preview
command.refresh.title: Re-translate
command.setApiKey.title: Set API Key
command.clearApiKey.title: Clear API Key
config.provider: The LLM provider used for translation.
config.targetLanguage: Target language for translation, e.g. 中文 / English / العربية (Arabic).
config.deepseek.model: DeepSeek model name. Default: `deepseek-flash` (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, non-thinking mode for translation).
config.openai.model: OpenAI model name. Default: `gpt-6-luna` (cost-effective, reasoning disabled for translation).
config.openai.baseUrl: OpenAI API base URL (can point to a compatible proxy).
config.claude.model: Claude model name. Default: `claude-haiku-4-5` (fast and cost-effective).
config.glm.baseUrl: Zhipu AI API base URL (without the `/v4` suffix).
config.qwen.baseUrl: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio API base URL (without the `/v1` suffix).
config.kimi.baseUrl: Moonshot AI API base URL (without the `/v1` suffix).
config.custom.model: Model name exposed by the OpenAI-compatible service.
config.custom.baseUrl: OpenAI-compatible API base URL including its version path, e.g. `https://api.siliconflow.cn/v1`.
config.doubao.model: Doubao model name or endpoint ID. Default: `doubao-seed-2-1-lite-260915`.
config.doubao.baseUrl: Volcano Engine Ark API base URL.
config.grok.model: Grok model name. Default: `grok-4.3` (cost-effective, reasoning disabled for translation). `grok-4.7` is also available at a higher price.
config.grok.baseUrl: xAI API base URL (without the `/v1` suffix).
